judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer's comment in Major Comment 4 mentions Bryan & Lee (2024) and the completeness maps, but does not challenge the use of 'Poisson statistics' versus 'binomial statistics'. The reviewer does not flag the statistical model categorization as contradicted by the cited sources.

The review discusses completeness maps from Bryan & Lee (2024) but does not challenge the claim that prior studies used Poisson statistics or otherwise compare that sentence against the cited sources. No specific citation-method mismatch is flagged.

The reviewer explicitly assesses the methodology as statistically sound and reviews the specific section and equation (Eq. 2) associated with this citation without flagging the incorrect categorization of Poisson statistics.

The reviewer does not challenge the use of 'Poisson statistics' in Section 3.1 or note that Bryan & Lee (2024) and Zhu (2024) use a binomial/Beta-posterior approach rather than Poisson statistics. The reviewer's comment on equation 2 (Minor Comment 5) only mentions formatting of the Beta distribution formula, without questioning the statistical model category.

The reviewer mentions the value 42.6% in Major Comment 2 but does not flag any discrepancy between the abstract value (42.6%) and a body value (4.26%). The reviewer appears to have only seen one consistent value and did not catch the mismatch.

The reviewer cites the 42.6% value in discussing mixed vs. sub-Neptune systems, but does not note any inconsistency between the abstract and Section 3.2 body value or mention the erroneous 4.26% figure. Therefore the abstract-vs-body numerical mismatch is not detected.
In Major Comment 2, the reviewer explicitly quotes the correct value of 42.6 percent while referencing Section 3.2, indicating they failed to notice the 4.26 percent typo present in the body text.

Minor Comment 5 only mentions formatting/spacing of the Beta distribution formula and does not flag the incorrect exponent (1-b instead of b-1) in the PDF. The reviewer did not identify the mathematical error in the exponent.

The only comment on Eq. 2 is a formatting/readability suggestion: "Check the formatting of the Beta distribution formula." This does not identify the incorrect exponent or the reversed boundary behavior, so it is not a detection of the mathematical error.

The reviewer examines Equation 2 in Minor Comment 5 and specifically mentions that the first term of the PDF is clear, but only suggests minor formatting changes for the Beta function, missing the catastrophic limit reversal in the exponent.

The reviewer does not flag any mismatch between the figure referenced and the claim about metal-rich conditional frequencies being larger than the field frequency. No comment addresses the wrong figure reference (metalpoor vs metalrich).

The reviewer mentions "some minor inconsistencies in the figures and text," but the only specific figure issues are y-axis labels and visualization clarity. They do not flag that the cited figure in Section 3.2 is the wrong metal-poor panel relative to the metal-rich excess claim.

The reviewer evaluates the findings in Section 3.2 and suggests corrections for figure labels elsewhere, but does not detect the cross-reference mismatch between the metal-rich prose and the metal-poor data figure.
